name: mu(W)
column4: v]/(dW). Also b_1 of the Milnor fibre of the plane-curve germ (a bouquet of 25 circles).

name: mu(W^T)
what_it_is: Same for the transpose germ. The extra monomial is v^{11} in (dW^T).

name: |det A| = |Aut(W)|
what_it_is: Order of the maximal diagonal symmetry group. Preserved by BHK transpose. Not mu.

name: dim Jac(F)
what_it_is: Thom-Sebastiani: three copies of the Jacobian algebra.

name: |Aut(F)|
what_it_is: Product of the three symmetry groups.

name: Hilbert of Jac(F)^J
what_it_is: Graded pieces of the J-invariants, degrees 0, 6, 12, 18, 24. Classical primitive Hodge numbers of any smooth sextic in P^5 (Griffiths 1968-69).

name: narrow line
what_it_is: Fixed loci of J, J^2, J^3, J^4, J^5 are the origin. One Lefschetz state each: 1, omega, omega^2, omega^3, omega^4.

name: degree
what_it_is: Volume of a sextic in P^5. One pairing on the narrow line.

name: 42 residue triples
what_it_is: Structure constants of Jac(W) against the socle u^3 v^5.
